verdict.rationale: ernd is a corporate card and rewards product for AI vendor spend. A built-in AI assistant is a plausible feature for a spend-management product, so the axis applies. However, the evidence only covers cashback rates, partner perks, travel redemption and card requests, and never mentions an in-product assistant that can take delegated tasks.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
